In `solve_model`, the callback now receives `n.snapshots.get_level_values("timestep")` whenever the network has investment periods. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, the model retains the network’s `(period, timestep)` MultiIndex, so this callback argument loses the period labels even for a full-horizon build and also ignores any subset used to build the model.
